name: RGL-80A electronet grenade launcher
description: The RGL-80A electronet grenade launcher was a type of stun net launcher manufactured by Golan Arms. A larger version of the company's RL-40 stun net launcher, the weapon held a magazine of five electronet grenades, and had a maximum range of five hundred meters. Similar to the pistol-sized RL-40, the RGL-80A could vary the intensity of the electrical shock delivered by means of a remote control.
